10300.title: Lovely 3-bedroom country villa with sea views, a short distance from the beach
10300.content:
Lovely villa set in the countryside, surrounded by trees and natural shrubs on a spacious and very private plot, just 300 m on foot from the beach and the centre of Salema. From the villa, balconies and terraces you can enjoy panoramic views over the countryside and sea views. There is also a swimming pool, and extensive terraces surround the villa. The villa has 2 floors. The upper floor comprises a garage, yard, hall and cloakroom, and a spacious living room leading to a sunny balcony with views over Salema and the sea. There is also a dining room, a fireplace, a fully equipped kitchen and a laundry room. The kitchen also gives access to a rear terrace and to the countryside part of the plot. On the lower floor there is a corridor fitted with wardrobes, a bathroom serving 2 spacious bedrooms, and a 3rd en-suite bedroom. All bedrooms open onto the spacious sunny terraces and the pool. Outside there are parking spaces and a garden, and the property is enclosed. The villa is also equipped with solar panels for hot water. The property has beautiful panoramic views over the countryside and sea views. Built area: 164 m2. Plot area: 10592.04 m2. A unique investment opportunity.
Price not negotiable.

10347.title: Romantic, luxurious and exclusive villa
10347.content:
This luxurious villa has recently undergone a complete renovation that has turned it into a real dream! The house has been carefully designed, with refined and very tasteful details in every room. Designed as an open plan, the space flows from a central kitchen island to the living room with a double fireplace on the upper floor. All rooms and bedrooms on the upper floor offer stunning panoramic views and complete privacy, each with its own en-suite. The lower floor has the guest area, with two further en-suites and direct access to the pool area. On the pool terrace you can enjoy a 270° view of the golf course, the landscape and the ocean. There is a very well equipped outdoor kitchen with barbecue, a jacuzzi, a fire pit for relaxing evenings and an outdoor shower. Lush, extensive Mediterranean gardens surround the property, offering private spaces for rest. Villa Surga has been tastefully designed, with exclusive and sophisticated details, a contemporary touch and high-quality equipment. Comfort, exclusivity, refinement and well-being are the principles that guide Villa Surga. This villa was also the setting for the popular Dutch holiday-home programme, which featured in the main media! Please contact us for more detailed information or to arrange a viewing.

10392.title: Charming traditional 4-bedroom villa with sea views
10392.content: Charming traditional villa with panoramic views over the Algarve landscape, a lively golf course and stunning views of the sea. This fully furnished 4-bedroom villa has distinctive features such as an infinity pool, garage and central heating, as well as a cosy fireplace. The fully equipped open-plan kitchen has a breakfast bar, making it a great place to entertain, and leads directly to the dining area. There is also a well-equipped pantry with a guest cloakroom opposite. The dining area, also connected to the living room, is spacious and comfortable with direct access to the terrace. The south-facing terrace wraps gracefully around the villa, offering unobstructed views in every direction. There is a mature garden, a large infinity pool, and garden furniture is included. Each bedroom conveniently has a bathroom, with a whirlpool bath in the main bedroom. Most bedrooms also have wardrobes and the added benefit of central heating. This villa is in excellent condition and really needs to be seen to fully appreciate its charm and its incredible views.

10466.title: Lovely 9,920 m² farm estate with two-bedroom house, garage, large warehouse, well and fruit trees
10466.content: Set in a very quiet rural area on the outskirts of Budens, this attractive farm estate is close to supermarkets, restaurants, a petrol station, a bakery and Boca do Rio beach. The south-facing house comprises an open-plan living and dining room with equipped kitchen, two spacious bedrooms and a bathroom with shower and laundry area. It has electric heating, a covered terrace ideal for relaxing and a large top-floor terrace with panoramic views over the countryside. Next to the house there is a spacious garage with office, and outdoor parking. The sale also includes a Kubota tractor with plough and rotavator. The property also has a large agricultural warehouse, a traditional bread oven, two gated entrances and three-phase electricity. The fertile 9,920 m² land has a well with abundant water and several productive fruit trees, including orange, pomegranate, fig, almond and pear trees, as well as a vineyard. Construction area: 238.41 m². Land area: 9,920 m². Sold furnished. A unique investment opportunity, ideal as a permanent residence, for farming or for a rural tourism project.

10378-A.title: Building plot with incredible sea views
10378-A.content:
Building plot with incredible sea views

Building plot located at Salema Beach, with incredible panoramic sea views. There is a project already approved by the Municipal Council for the plot, which will allow the construction of a house with its own pool and private parking. All the houses will benefit from the unique sea views. It could be a great investment. It will be possible to have different building projects for each of the 8 plots for sale. For example: a complex of tourist buildings (buying the whole group of plots), a single large house, or houses with good floor areas. Please ask for more details.

10400 A.title: Modern apartment near the beach with private parking and shared pool
10400 A.content: This lovely apartment is located in the centre of Salema, on the second floor, a few metres from all amenities and the beach. The apartment also has an excellent private parking space in a shared basement, spacious storage rooms and access to a shared pool. Inside, the apartment has an entrance hall leading to a fully furnished and equipped kitchen with a private, sunny balcony. The dining area and living room open onto an outdoor balcony with a seating area. The apartment also has a bathroom with heated towel rails and 2 spacious bedrooms, both with wardrobes. One of them also has access to the balcony. The apartment also has a central heating system. It is sold fully furnished. Built in 2004. Construction area: 76.40 m². An excellent apartment for holidays and letting, and a great investment opportunity.

10284.title: 5-bedroom villa with pool and golf views
10284.content:
Two-storey T5 villa with 410 m2 of construction area and 1470 m2 of total land area, within the Santo António Golf Resort. This villa comprises 5 bedrooms (1 office), 4 bathrooms (3 of them en suite), a living/dining room with fireplace and air conditioning, an equipped kitchen, a laundry room and two large balconies with access to all bedrooms, the living room and the kitchen, with panoramic views of the golf course, the countryside, the 9th green, the driving range and the bowling area. A spacious pool area with jacuzzi and barbecue, protected by a side wall with windows. A garden all around the house. Outdoor parking for two cars.

10464.title: Semi-detached 2-bedroom townhouse
10464.content:
Enjoy stunning panoramic ocean views from this beautifully presented townhouse, situated on the exclusive small development ‘The View’ in the idyllic fishing village of Salema. A five-minute stroll leads you to the beautiful wide sandy beach, as well as the excellent restaurants and cafes that Salema has to offer.
As soon as you walk through the front door, you are greeted with spectacular sea views from the living room terrace. The bright and airy open-plan living/dining room opens onto a spacious terrace with a barbecue and dining area. The fully equipped kitchen with built-in appliances and granite worktops opens onto another beautiful terrace with stairs leading to a spectacular rooftop terrace, all with breathtaking sea views.
The lower floor features two good-sized bedrooms. One is a large double with an en-suite bathroom, with a jacuzzi bath and shower over. The second a spacious twin bedroom with en-suite shower room. Both bedrooms have patio doors which open onto a large covered terrace with private gardens beyond.
The house comes to the market fully furnished with underfloor heating, air conditioning, double glazing and a wood burner to ensure year-round comfort.
‘The View’ is an established luxury resort with a large communal pool and separate children’s pool. All of which are surrounded by beautiful, well-maintained gardens in a peaceful and tranquil setting. This exceptional home is set in one of the most sought-after locations in the western Algarve.

10465.title: Lovely two-bedroom house with leisure terraces and a large studio/storage area
10465.content: This charming single-storey house was fully renovated in 2019 and is ideally located in the centre of Budens, a short walk from all the essential amenities, including a supermarket, bakery, cafés, restaurants and public transport. The main house comprises a spacious living and dining room, a corridor leading to a modern shower room, two generously sized bedrooms and a fully equipped kitchen with a separate pantry. The living room and one of the bedrooms have energy-efficient electric stone heaters. Outside, the property has a large private terrace, ideal for outdoor dining, relaxing and socialising. A very spacious detached annex, which can be used as a studio or storage, offers excellent extra space for accommodation or work, and includes a shower room and a separate storeroom. Above this annex is a large roof terrace, furnished with a table and chairs, offering another pleasant leisure area. There is also storage space under the stairs. The property benefits from a local accommodation (Alojamento Local) licence, is fully furnished and is in immaculate condition. Built area: 141.30 m²; Total area: 165 m². An excellent investment opportunity, equally suitable as a permanent residence, holiday home or licensed rental property.

10409.title: 2-bedroom apartment
10409.content: Well-located ground-floor apartment with 2 spacious bedrooms with built-in wardrobes. Large open-plan kitchen and dining room, renovated 3 years ago. Sea view and easy access to the beach. Total built area 55.25 m2.

10270.title: Land with house next to the beach
10270.content:
Land located at Praia das Furnas. Part of the land is at the entrance to Praia das Furnas and the other part is on the plateau. The land also has a recently renovated 50 m² building next to the beach entrance. The building has a small entrance hall, a bedroom with private bathroom with shower, and a large living room with integrated kitchen and fireplace. The building also has a solar energy system, and the kitchen is equipped with a fridge and microwave. An ideal investment opportunity! The total land area is 10,080 m².
